videos.overview: Carla ends her business relationship with Leanne and demands to know whether she slept with Paul; Liz and Derek flirt at a licencees' party, despite being accompanied by their other halves; and Kirk asks Chesney to spy on Fiz.

videos.title: June 4, 2007 Part 1 (6569)
videos.overview: Paul begs an unforgiving Carla to take him back, and arranges to meet up with Leanne to ask her to talk to his wife; and Liz is put in a tight spot when Linda confesses she thinks Derek is having an affair.

videos.title: June 4, 2007 Part 2 (6570)
videos.overview: With Leanne locked in the boot of his car, Paul arranges to meet Liam at his flat, where he intends to reveal all about Leanne's work as an escort; and Sarah is furious with David for telling Gail about Jason moving in with them.

videos.title: June 6, 2007 (6571)
videos.overview: Carla and Liam keep a vigil at Paul's bedside following the car crash, while Michelle arrives just as the doctors deliver some bad news; Leanne tries to explain her part in the accident, but Liam cannot forgive her; and Jerry helps Eileen redecorate the Peacocks' house.

videos.title: June 8, 2007 (6572)
videos.overview: Ken decides to visit Deirdre, but is dejected to see her having a night out at the Rovers. When he is also blanked by Daniel, he confides his sorrows in Denise - who moves in for a kiss. Janice sticks up for Leanne when Kelly spreads gossip about her involvement with Paul; Mel wants to know more about her granddad's past; and Eileen agrees to go for a drink with Jerry.

videos.title: June 10, 2007 (6573)
videos.overview: Ken realises he made a mistake by sleeping with Denise, but Deirdre needs convincing to take him back; Steve and Leanne feel left out as the Connors prepare for Paul's funeral in Ireland; Jerry suggests Mel should take her granddad for a drink to get him to reveal more about the past; and Gail remains adamant that David must sit the rest of his exams.

videos.title: June 11, 2007 Part 1 (6574)
videos.overview: David agrees to sit another exam, but sets fire to his work just as the papers are being collected; and the Peacocks return to the Street - but are still troubled by the fact that they don't know who started the fire.

videos.title: June 11, 2007 Part 2 (6575)
videos.overview: Bethany's birthday party is ruined when David's teacher arrives to tell Gail about her son's behaviour in the exam; and Fiz tries to tell Kirk about John but backs out at the last minute, leaving him convinced they still have a future together.

videos.title: June 13, 2007 (6576)
videos.overview: Fiz believes Kirk is to blame when her bike is vandalised, but comes to realise that he still doesn't know about her and John; Claire becomes paranoid that she is still being targeted by someone after receiving an anonymous phone call; and Gail is furious with David for showing no remorse over his actions, so decides to find him a job.

videos.title: June 15, 2007 Part 1 (6577)
videos.overview: Claire becomes paranoid and shouts at a woman in the street who she believes to be Casey - leaving Josh stranded in the middle of the road in the path of an oncoming car. Cilla offers Kirk the benefit of her advice as Fiz discovers who really vandalised her scooter; and Gail asks Jason to befriend David at the builders' yard, but her son plans to make his colleague feel uneasy.

videos.title: June 15, 2007 Part 2 (6578)
videos.overview: The cab office gets a visit from Eileen's flirtatious telephone pal Pat; Claire's silent caller also pays a visit to the street - and rings her again from a nearby phone box; David learns Jason is afraid of heights, so takes away his ladder while he's on a roof; and Jerry is shocked when the local paper prints an obituary for his father - who is not dead.

videos.title: June 18, 2007 Part 1 (6579)
videos.overview: The Peacocks find a camera - and one of the photos proves that Claire has been telling the truth about Casey; Bill agrees to take David back; and Leanne prepares to face the world.

videos.title: June 18, 2007 Part 2 (6580)
videos.overview: The Peacocks hope for a quick result when the police release Casey's photo to the public; and the Connors are back from Ireland, but Leanne soon realises things will never be the same again.

videos.title: June 20, 2007 (6581)
videos.overview: The Peacocks are delighted to hear Casey has handed herself into the police, but not so happy when she is released without charge - especially when she turns up on their doorstep demanding an explanation; Leanne needs a quick way to earn £6,000 now that Carla has pulled out of the restaurant deal; Michelle finds it tough lying to Ryan about Paul; and Liam is struggling to cope with the pain of his brother's death, prompting him to make a hasty decision.

videos.title: June 22, 2007 (6582)
videos.overview: Claire discovers Casey's address and drags Ashley off to confront the woman she believes abducted their son, but her agitated state only serves to spark fresh doubts about her own mental health; Vernon lets slip to Ryan that Leanne was involved in Paul's death, while Leanne herself considers going to a money lender to get the extra cash she needs for the restaurant; and David returns to work at the builders' yard, but doesn't make the greatest of starts when he arrives late.

videos.title: June 24, 2007 (6583)
videos.overview: Claire still isn't convinced of Casey's innocence; Audrey has a proposition for David; and Steve is upset when Michelle plans a trip without him.

videos.title: June 25, 2007 Part 1 (6584)
videos.overview: When Carla again refuses to invest in the restaurant venture, Leanne vows to raise the cash to open the business herself; and Blanche holds her own wake in the Rovers, but is disappointed by the turnout.

videos.title: June 25, 2007 Part 2 (6585)
videos.overview: Leanne considers returning to escort work to fund the restaurant after making a deal with the owner, but finds she can't bring herself to do it and turns to Janice for advice; and Blanche is shocked by some of the eulogies at her wake - and is surprised by what Ken has to say.

videos.title: June 27, 2007 (6586)
videos.overview: Janice and Leanne ask Roger for a loan to fund the restaurant, but he discovers that Leanne has been working as an escort and walks out on the pair; Violet confides in Sean about her desperation for a baby, but he's concerned about how she would cope as a single mother; Carla discovers Paul has left her everything, including his share of the factory; and Audrey and Gail are surprised when David's first day working at the salon goes well.

videos.title: June 29, 2007 (6587)
videos.overview: Sean invites Violet for a picnic and shocks her by suggesting that he would like to father her child; Janice and Roger visit the restaurant to check up on his investment - just as Leanne is beginning to panic about taking such a huge financial risk; Eileen is thrilled when Pat finally calls to arrange another date; and Chesney upsets Roy by revealing the cafe has come bottom in the school's green audit.

videos.title: July 1, 2007 (6588)
videos.overview: Violet considers Sean's suggestion for them to have a baby together; Jerry is dismayed when Eileen and Pat call in to the takeaway; and Jack begs Molly to reconsider moving out.

videos.title: July 2, 2007 Part 1 (6589)
videos.overview: Violet tells Sean she doesn't want to waste any time in trying for a baby; Hayley finds it difficult to cope at Underworld as the workers continue to take advantage of her, and decides to ask for Carla's help; and Jerry tries to hide his feelings after Lloyd catches Pat leaving Eileen's house.

videos.title: July 2, 2007 Part 2 (6590)
videos.overview: Carla makes her mark at the factory by banning mobile phones; Violet and Sean's attempts at making a baby don't go according to plan; Steve and Lloyd are concerned when Jamie tells them he thinks Pat is married; and Fiz worries Cilla's behaviour will put John off as they go for tea at Hayley's.

videos.title: July 4, 2007 (6591)
videos.overview: Steve and Lloyd launch a surveillance operation to find out whether Pat is married, and their suspicions gain weight when he returns home with a woman; an exhausted Sean struggles to keep up with Violet's demands; Leanne begins an advertising campaign for the restaurant; and Vera has a change of heart about Molly and Tyrone's move - but it seems their plans will be put on hold after Jack injures his back.

videos.title: July 6, 2007 (6592)
videos.overview: Eileen is furious to discover that Pat is already married and attempts to end their relationship; Cilla and Yana try to attract customers back to the chip shop by arranging for the pest-control inspector to visit Jerry's takeaway, leading to an angry confrontation with Jodie; Molly is grateful when Betty and Emily offer to help care for the Duckworths; and Carla infuriates Sally by offering Hayley a promotion.

videos.title: July 8, 2007 (6593)
videos.overview: Liam returns to find Carla in charge of the factory and is furious to discover Paul has left her half of his company; and Eileen tries to find out where she stands with Pat.

videos.title: July 9, 2007 Part 1 (6594)
videos.overview: Liz returns to Weatherfield and is persuaded by Derek to come up to the flat; Sarah and Jason return from holiday with news for Gail; Sally prepares for her 40th birthday; and Leanne plans the opening of her restaurant.

videos.title: July 9, 2007 Part 2 (6595)
videos.overview: The grand opening of Leanne's restaurant doesn't go according to plan when the heating proves too powerful and the bar runs out of alcohol; and Sally is furious when Carla considers offering Rosie the PA job at the factory.

videos.title: July 11, 2007 (6596)
videos.overview: After confiding in Betty about her predicament, Liz confesses to Linda that she is the other woman in Derek's life; and Rosie and Sophie are embarrassed as Sally enjoys a wild night out on her 40th birthday.

videos.title: July 13, 2007 (6597)
videos.overview: The Duckworths' grandson Paul Clayton arrives in Weatherfield to help look after his relatives, although Tyrone is suspicious when the newcomer asks for money and flirts with Maria; Carla asks Rosie to compile files on all the factory employees before firing Joanne, claiming the business is over-staffed; Sally and Kevin skive off work and have a day out to reinvigorate their relationship; and Vernon confides in Dev as he plans a surprise for Liz.

videos.title: July 15, 2007 (6598)
videos.overview: Liz is horrified to see Derek chatting with Vernon, and faces a tough decision when he threatens to reveal all about the affair unless she continues seeing him. Claire fails to share Ashley's enthusiasm over Freddie's birthday; and Gail makes a complaint about the volume of Darryl's guitar.

videos.title: July 16, 2007 Part 1 (6599)
videos.overview: Ashley is horrified when Claire goes missing; Liz grows concerned about Vernon's whereabouts; and Liam confronts Carla over Joanne's sacking.

videos.title: July 16, 2007 Part 2 (6600)
videos.overview: Vernon snubs Liz's efforts to make amends; Ashley is shocked to find Casey on his doorstep claiming she wants to apologise to Claire; and Liam offers Joanne her old job back.

videos.title: July 18, 2007 Part 2 (6601)
videos.overview: Tyrone shares his suspicions about Paul with Molly and is upset when Jack chooses to play cards with his grandson instead of him; Carla sacks Joanne again and reminds Liam that, as the major shareholder in the factory, her decision is final; Claire decides to return to Yvonne's, where Casey pays her a visit; and Eileen introduces Pat to Jason and Sarah.

videos.title: July 20, 2007 (6602)
videos.overview: Leanne has a stressful day at the restaurant and feels guilty when Janice reveals Roger has invested all his savings in the venture; Casey helps Ashley by looking after the shop and taking care of Josh, prompting him to invite her for a drink; Joanne threatens Carla and Liam with a tribunal; and Liz is upset to learn Vernon plans to move to Spain.

videos.title: July 22, 2007 (6603)
videos.overview: As Vernon prepares to leave for Spain, Liz begs a second chance and asks if she can go with him. Maria agrees to go for a drink with Liam; Ashley visits Claire and tells her he can't cope by himself; and Jason sees Eileen with Pat.

videos.title: July 23, 2007 Part 1 (6604)
videos.overview: Casey visits the Street to help Ashley cope in Claire's absence; Leanne doesn't get off to a good start with her chef; Sean persuades Violet to take a pregnancy test; and Liz and Vernon struggle to maintain a united front.

videos.title: July 23, 2007 Part 2 (6605)
videos.overview: Casey proves a big help to Ashley, so he invites her to stay for dinner; Leanne is annoyed when Paul criticises her food; and Sally resolves to better herself by studying English literature.

videos.title: July 25, 2007 (6606)
videos.overview: Ashley pays Claire a visit but is surprised when Casey opens the door, and panics that she might have told his wife about their kiss; Leanne needs a new chef - and it looks like Paul could be just the man; Violet worries that Jamie has found out about her arrangement with Sean; and Blanche stakes out the Rovers ladies' toilets to discover who's been smoking.

videos.title: July 27, 2007 (6607)
videos.overview: Violet tells Sean the happy news, so they decide to go for an early scan because of her past problems; things are looking up for Leanne as Paul starts work at the restaurant and immediately makes his mark; Claire returns home to Ashley; and John offers to help Sally with her studies.

videos.title: July 29, 2007 (6608)
videos.overview: Sean tells Jamie he's going to be a father but refuses to name the mother - only to give the game away; Eileen is annoyed when her friends put a damper on her relationship with Pat.

videos.title: July 30, 2007 Part 1 (6609)
videos.overview: Steve reads Pat's text messages, which reveal the truth about the Irish charmer's wife; and Casey persuades Claire to attend a support group - before dropping in on Ashley for another cosy chat.

videos.title: July 30, 2007 Part 2 (6610)
videos.overview: Claire is feeling more positive after her support group meeting and tells Ashley he should attend the next one with her; and a depressed Steve books himself a cheap holiday to Malta - only for an equally miserable Eileen to invite herself along.

videos.title: Aug 1, 2007 (6611)
videos.overview: Eileen's holiday with Steve is soured when they end up having to share a room - and a bed. However, things soon look up for Eileen when holiday rep Aidan takes a shine to her; Casey continues to come between the Peacocks; and Leanne and Paul enjoy their most successful lunchtime so far.

videos.title: Aug 3, 2007 (6612)
videos.overview: Steve is confused when he wakes up to find Eileen asleep next to him, especially as his companion says she can't remember what went on the night before. However, he perks up later when he meets sexy holiday-maker Shania - unaware she isn't all she seems. Back on the cobbles, the Peacocks realise the locals still suspect Claire of starting the fire; Sarah backs Jason into a corner regarding their wedding; and Sophie dresses to impress Sally's tutor John.

videos.title: Aug 5, 2007 (6613)
videos.overview: Steve is relieved when Eileen decides to keep last night's close shave to herself, and the pair vow they'll always be there for each other; Janice is forced to make a decision; and at the Platts', Gail and Sarah prepare for the vicar's visit.

videos.title: Aug 6, 2007 Part 1 (6614)
videos.overview: Steve arrives home with Eileen and tries to convince Liz he is over Michelle, but his feelings are put to the test when she returns to the Street; and DI Parks questions the witnesses to the fire again.

videos.title: Aug 6, 2007 Part 2 (6615)
videos.overview: Michelle and Steve have a heart to heart, and it's not long before their true feelings come to the fore; Cilla considers a new career; and Norris decides to go to Angela's funeral.

videos.title: Aug 8, 2007
videos.overview: Casey keeps tabs on the Peacock household, then arranges to meet Claire - who confides she thinks the police believe she is the arsonist; Michelle tells Ryan about her relationship with Steve; and Norris attends Angela's funeral, which ends as the other ex-husbands revel in raucous shenanigans in the Rovers.

videos.title: Aug 10, 2007
videos.overview: Casey seizes the opportunity to increase Claire's paranoia and offers her drastic advice - which she unwittingly takes to heart; Carla decides it's time to move out of Michelle's flat; Eileen accidentally lets slip about Shania; and Norris remains tight-lipped about his new friends.

videos.title: Aug 12, 2007 (6618)
videos.overview: When Claire fears she's getting ill again, Casey suggest she should go and stay with her mother for a while; and Tyrone leaves for Spain after learning his mother has been arrested.

videos.title: Aug 13, 2007 Part 1 (6619)
videos.overview: After telling Carla and Liam how in love she is, Michelle finds some of Steve's holiday snaps and is furious to see one of him with Shania; and Casey continues to manipulate Claire by taking Josh on a trip to the museum.

videos.title: Aug 13, 2007 Part 2 (6620)
videos.overview: Steve struggles to make peace with Michelle as Lloyd's meddling fails to help his cause; Carla offers Rosie a full-time job at the factory; and David's drink with Mel ends in disaster.

videos.title: Aug 15, 2007
videos.overview: After the locals discover that Casey has spent another night at the Peacocks' house, Kevin questions Ashley about what's been going on. Sarah is shocked to learn of David's whereabouts the previous night; Michelle forgives Steve for what went on in Malta; and Carla gloats to Sally about Rosie accepting a full-time job.

videos.title: Aug 17, 2007 (6622)
videos.overview: Audrey urges Ashley to think twice about his relationship with Casey and he agrees to slow things down. As Steve begins to feel smug about winning back Michelle, Eileen decides to have more fun with the holiday photos. Sally tries to persuade Rosie to change her mind about taking a full-time job at the factory; and David vetoes Bill's idea to extend the Platt house.

videos.title: Aug 19, 2007 (6623)
videos.overview: David learns that Sarah’s interference is the reason Mel failed to show up for their date; Cilla begins work at the care home and starts flirting with one of the OAPs when she realises he comes from a well-off background; and Jack entrusts Paul with the task of buying a present for Vera.

videos.title: Aug 20, 2007 Part 1 (6624)
videos.overview: Paul's reaction intrigues Leanne when he seems strangely calm after she confides in him about the restaurant's financial state; Michelle asks Steve to come on a trip to see her relatives in Ireland; and David spreads lies about why he and Mel are no longer an item.

videos.title: Aug 20, 2007 Part 2 (6625)
videos.overview: David is furious when he is forced to apologise to Mel; Leanne laughs off Paul's suggestion that he could invest in the restaurant; and Frank offers Cilla a job as his private carer.

videos.title: Aug 22, 2007 (6626)
videos.overview: Jack and Vera celebrate their 50th wedding anniversary and Molly takes care to ensure that their party at the Rovers goes without a hitch; Gail is annoyed with David when he claims to have not bothered picking up his exam result; and Eileen and Jerry enjoy their first date.

videos.title: Aug 24, 2007 (6627)
videos.overview: Paul steals the deeds from the Duckworth's house and proceeds to apply for a loan in his grandfather's name; Jerry finds himself drawn even closer to Eileen as she helps out Mel when the girl is harassed by two lads at the takeaway; and Casey tells Ashley that she plans to move away from Weatherfield.

videos.title: Aug 26, 2007
videos.overview: Jerry arranges a romantic evening with Eileen in Darryl's shed to get some privacy, but Gail is disgusted to see the couple together. Audrey tries to persuade Claire to return to the Street; Ashley makes a decision about Casey; and Paul convinces Leanne to spend more money on the restaurant rather than paying back her debt to Roger.

videos.title: Aug 27, 2007 Part 1 (6629)
videos.overview: Casey spends the night with Ashley, but Claire returns home unexpectedly the next day; and Frank finds it hard to take his eyes off Cilla as she becomes his carer.

videos.title: Aug 27, 2007 Part 2 (6630)
videos.overview: Casey is furious when Ashley tells her to stay away from his family while he repairs his relationship with Claire; Roy persuades a nervous Hayley to attend her aunt's funeral; and Rita, Doreen and Emily are baffled by Norris's strange behaviour.

videos.title: Aug 29, 2007 (6631)
videos.overview: Hayley faces hostility from her family when she attends her aunt's funeral, and the discovery of a letter addressed to her leaves her in a state of shock; Claire moves back in with Ashley, although Casey refuses to leave the couple alone; and Betty is intrigued by what Norris says to his friends.

videos.title: Aug 31, 2007 (6632)
videos.overview: Hayley confides in Becky that she fathered a son before her sex-change operation and is worried how Roy will take the news; Emily fears that Norris is going to propose when he invites her for dinner; Ashley takes the day off work to spend some time with Claire, but Casey tries to come between the couple; and Tyrone grows concerned about Paul's influence over the Duckworths.

videos.title: Sep 2, 2007 (6633)
videos.overview: Casey steps up her harassment of Ashley and Claire; Norris takes Rita out for a meal, where he reveals that he's recently realised he loves her and proposes; David is furious with Gail for showing him up in front of Mel; and Becky attempts to convince Hayley to track down her son.

videos.title: Sep 3, 2007 Part 1 (6634)
videos.overview: Casey kidnaps Freddie and takes him to her flat, where she threatens to jump from the balcony unless Ashley agrees to talk to her; and Hayley and Becky meet a detective who could help them track down Hayley's son.

videos.title: Sep 3, 2007 Part 2 (6635)
videos.overview: After learning of Ashley's affair, Claire confronts Casey about her actions and tries to talk her out of jumping off the balcony with Freddie; and Jerry is furious when Kayleigh's drunken antics put an end to his date with Eileen.

videos.title: Sep 5, 2007 (6636)
videos.overview: Claire refuses to talk to Ashley after the incident at Casey's flat and berates Audrey for not telling her what was going on; Gail finds herself in the firing line when David tries out Darryl's air rifle; and Jerry feels guilty about Kayleigh's drinking and cancels a date with Eileen so he can spend time with her.

videos.title: Sep 7, 2007 (6637)
videos.overview: When Gail tells him to start paying rent, David packs his bags and declares he is leaving home; Sean accompanies Violet to the hospital for a scan, where he finds himself attracted to a sonographer; Ashley fears he's lost Claire for good and is devastated to discover she's planning their future apart; and Liam and Maria agree to go on a date after he returns from his business trip.

videos.title: Sep 9, 2007 (6638)
videos.overview: Gail is shocked by a visit from the police, who've found a badly beaten David in the city centre and accuse her of the assault; as he and Violet tell the locals that they're having a baby, Sean is especially pleased to hear from sonographer Marcus again; and Ashley's hopes of a reconciliation with Claire are dashed.

videos.title: Sep 10, 2007 Part 1 (6639)
videos.overview: Hayley discovers the private detective has tracked down her son and plans to visit him, though Becky warns her to be careful about revealing her identity just yet; and Sean and Violet try not to pay attention to the factory girls' gossip about their having a baby together.

videos.title: Sep 10, 2007 Part 2 (6640)
videos.overview: Hayley loses her nerve when she visits her son at the record shop, and decides it is time to confess the truth to Roy; Ashley breaks down in the Rovers after telling Josh that he is splitting up with Claire; and Sally's snobbish instincts come to the fore.

videos.title: Sep 12, 2007 (6641)
videos.overview: As Roy struggles to come to terms with her deceit, Hayley prepares to meet her son - but the encounter results in her telling more lies. Claire feels the strain of her separation from Ashley and forgives Audrey, but remains adamant that her marriage is over.

videos.title: Sep 16, 2007 (6642 and 6643)
videos.overview: Roy can't bear to play along with Hayley's lies and ends up making Christian unwelcome at the cafe; a suspicious Tyrone sets a trap for Paul; Sean celebrates his birthday in style with Marcus; David offers to look after a stash of drugs for Darryl; and Carla lands an unexpected admirer.

videos.title: Sep 17, 2007 Part 1 (6644)
videos.overview: When David leaves Bethany unattended, she swallows one of the hidden Ecstasy tablets and starts convulsing. Tyrone apologises to Paul; and Violet seeks solace in the pub when Sean goes out with Trevor again.

videos.title: Sep 17, 2007 Part 2 (6645)
videos.overview: David is forced to confess that Bethany swallowed an Ecstasy tablet as the hospital staff fight to save her life; and Jamie tells Violet his seemingly sober mother is getting married next week, and invites her to the wedding.

videos.title: Sep 19, 2007 (6646)
videos.overview: David is told by the police he will face manslaughter charges if Bethany doesn't pull through; Sally realises she's enjoying her lessons with John for more than purely academic reasons; and Hayley and Roy drift further apart.

videos.title: Sep 21, 2007 (6647)
videos.overview: Audrey comes to David's aid and pleads with Gail not to give up on her son, who spent the night in Darryl's shed; Roy tells Hayley she must come clean with Christian if she plans to see him again; Sally isn't pleased when John extends the theatre invitation to Kevin and Fiz; and Liam returns to find Carla has struck up a friendship with Tony, and wonders if there's more to it than meets the eye.

videos.title: Sep 23, 2007 (6648)
videos.overview: Hayley tells Becky that she's decided to tell the truth; Gail is cold towards David when he comes to collect his belongings; and Liz remains tight-lipped about her wedding date when Steve and Michelle return home from Ireland.

videos.title: Sep 24, 2007 Part 1 (6649)
videos.overview: When Christian visits the cafe and asks to be taken to his father's grave, Roy begs Hayley to finally reveal her identity to him; and Audrey comes under fire from her family for continuing to support David.

videos.title: Sep 24, 2007 Part 2 (6650)
videos.overview: Christian is disgusted to learn that Hayley is his father and violently rejects her, though she blames Roy for forcing her to confess the truth; and Sally's hopes of a sophisticated evening with John are dashed.

videos.title: Sep 26, 2007 (6651)
videos.overview: As Hayley hides away in the flat, blaming Roy for ruining her relationship with Christian, Becky intervenes and encourages Roy to sort things out; and Jamie and Violet get back from Carol's wedding, where they seem to have grown closer.

videos.title: Sep 30, 2007 (6652 and 6653)
videos.overview: Hayley spends the night at Becky's while a devastated Roy struggles to keep his head above water in the cafe; Tyrone's efforts to expose Paul backfire; and Liam's flirty banter with Maria in the Rovers is short-lived after he hears Carla has been drinking there with Tony.

videos.title: Oct 1, 2007 Part 1 (6654)
videos.overview: Liam loses his cool when Carla arrives late at the factory and accuses her of sleeping with Tony; Roy and Hayley take a break to sort things out; and Becky confronts Christian in the record shop.

videos.title: Oct 1, 2007 Part 2 (6655)
videos.overview: Liam struggles with his feelings for Carla, who warns him not to make a move on her; Sarah refuses to work with David; and Molly backs up Tyrone in his fight with Paul.

videos.title: Oct 3, 2007 (6656)
videos.overview: Liam and Carla struggle with their feelings for one another as they play a game of one-upmanship with their respective dates Maria and Tony; Jason loses his cool with an apologetic David; and Frank asks Cilla to be his live-in carer.

videos.title: Oct 5, 2007 Part 1 (6657)
videos.overview: David feels disheartened after his run-in with Jason, but when he hears Gail is softening towards him he takes her some flowers; Liam can't shrug off his feelings for Carla and is annoyed when Tony bombards her with red roses; and Lloyd asks Jodie out on a date.

videos.title: Oct 5, 2007 Part 2 (6658)
videos.overview: Sarah and Jason bar David from their wedding, but he assures his sister there won't be a big day; Violet is forced to work at the pub when Sean fails to turn up, but is rushed to hospital when she starts to feel unwell; Jodie is left in charge of Finlay's party; and Claire returns home to find Ashley asleep on the sofa.

videos.title: Oct 8, 2007 Part 1 (6659)
videos.overview: Cilla tells everyone she's in line for a windfall; a guilty Sean promises Violet that his partying days are over; and Jodie warns Jerry not to meddle after he bribes Lloyd to take her out.

videos.title: Oct 8, 2007 Part 2 (6660)
videos.overview: Cilla is disappointed to learn the value of her inheritance from Frank; Jerry leaves Jodie holding the fort again; and Carla books a business trip away to escape her emotional turmoil.

videos.title: Oct 10, 2007 (6661)
videos.overview: Cilla toys with the idea of starting a new life in Las Vegas, but fails to consider Chesney in her plans; Paul is entrusted with Tyrone's duties when the Duckworths head off to Blackpool; Jodie discovers Jerry has gone back on his word; and tired of being treated like a soft touch, Roger takes a firm stance with Leanne.

videos.title: Oct 12, 2007 Part 1 (6662)
videos.overview: An irate Fiz discovers Cilla's one-way ticket to Las Vegas and confronts her mum in the Rovers; Molly and Tyrone delay their plans for a flat to keep their eye on Paul; Leanne's debt drives a wedge between Janice and Roger; and Jodie reaches the end of her tether as Kevin and Jerry prepare for their weekend away.

videos.title: Oct 12, 2007 Part 2 (6663)
videos.overview: Paul beats a hasty retreat from the restaurant when he sees two heavies waiting at the bar and begs Tyrone for help when they come knocking on his door; Chesney's welfare is on everyone's minds but, at the mention of social services, Fiz says she and Kirk can cope; Todd receives his wedding invitation; and Kevin and Jerry set off for Milan.

videos.title: Oct 15, 2007 Part 1 (6664)
videos.overview: Jason can't summon the courage to tell Sarah that Todd will be attending the wedding, but she finds out herself when she bumps into him in the street; Sally's attraction to John is the subject of gossip among the factory girls; and Fiz tells Kirk that Chesney should move in with her.

videos.title: Oct 15, 2007 Part 2 (6665)
videos.overview: Sarah refuses to allow David's trouble-making to get to her, but a series of disasters involving her wedding dress leads her to believe her big day is doomed; and Paul borrows more money in Jack's name to help Leanne with the restaurant.

videos.title: Oct 17, 2007 (6666)
videos.overview: Sarah catches up with Todd and agrees to try to put the past behind them, suggesting he should be Jason's best man - further infuriating David; Fiz grows frustrated by John's interest in the Websters; and Liam confronts Rosie about not passing on Maria's message.

videos.title: Oct 19, 2007 (6667)
videos.overview: Following her row with Liam, Rosie takes the day off work - and when John calls round to check on her, the pair end up kissing; David feels left out after Gail takes the rest of the family and the Grimshaws out for a meal; and Hayley returns from her trip and tells Becky her plans for filling the void in her life.

videos.title: Oct 21, 2007 (6668)
videos.overview: A guilty John finds himself being seduced by Rosie when he tries to make amends for their kiss; Sarah is lulled into a false sense of security when David keeps a low profile by hiding in his car; and Roy visits the record shop to talk to Christian.

videos.title: Oct 22, 2007 Part 1 (6669)
videos.overview: David sets out to sabotage the builders' yard, deleting messages from the answering machine and loosening some of the bolts on the scaffolding - placing Jason in grave danger; and Maria catches Liam kissing a glamorous stranger outside the factory.

videos.title: Oct 22, 2007 Part 2 (6670)
videos.overview: As Jason is rushed to hospital after falling from the scaffolding, David shows no remorse; and Rosie announces that she plans to return to school so she can continue her relationship with John.

videos.title: Oct 24, 2007 (6671)
videos.overview: After he is released from hospital, Jason tells Gail that he suspects David tampered with the scaffolding and caused the accident; John's tutoring session with Sally gives Rosie another opportunity to get closer to him; and Violet becomes uneasy when Sean asks to know the sex of the baby at her scan.

videos.title: Oct 26, 2007 (6672)
videos.overview: Gail confronts David about the accident and orders him to stay away from the family; Sean goes behind Violet's back by tricking Marcus into revealing the sex of the baby; and Jodie has to cut short her date with Lloyd after Kayleigh misbehaves for Eileen.

videos.title: Oct 28, 2007 (6673)
videos.overview: Feeling left out of the wedding, David tells Darryl that he believes Gail wishes she'd never had him, while Sarah becomes convinced something nasty is going to happen on her big day; and Jamie is put in an uncomfortable position when Sean reveals he knows the sex of Violet's baby.

videos.title: Oct 29, 2007 Part 1 (6674)
videos.overview: After learning that Martin won't be coming to the wedding to sort things out, David writes a suicide note that Sarah later finds; and Jamie and Liam struggle to cope with having a puppy around the house.

videos.title: Oct 29, 2007 Part 2 (6675)
videos.overview: Sarah confides in Maria about David's suicide note, but they decide it's another wind-up and ignore it; Liam bonds with the puppy; and Liz mistakenly thinks Vernon is making big plans for her 50th birthday.

videos.title: Oct 31, 2007 (6676)
videos.overview: It's the day of Sarah and Jason's wedding and despite the Platts' fears for David, they decide to go through with the ceremony anyway. Furious at their betrayal, David phones Gail to say a final farewell before driving his car into the canal. As the happy couple prepare to take their vows, the police arrive at the church with some devastating news that could ruin the big day.

videos.title: Nov 2, 2007 (6677)
videos.overview: Sarah is furious with David for ruining her wedding day and can't believe that Jason feels sorry for him; Liz is disappointed when her 50th birthday party is a wash-out, though Vernon cheers her up with a surprise gift; and Sally mistakes the affection John is showing for Rosie as being aimed at her, causing more upset for Kevin.

videos.title: Nov 4, 2007 (6678)
videos.overview: Sarah and Jason's first days of marriage are beset by bickering as the attention lavished on David drives a wedge between them; and Maria is disappointed when Liam reveals he is going to Ireland without her.

videos.title: Nov 5, 2007 Part 1 (6679)
videos.overview: Sally reveals her feelings to John; and David ruins Sarah's plans to have belated wedding photos taken.

videos.title: Nov 5, 2007 Part 2 (6680)
videos.overview: Michelle and Ryan move into the Rovers; Sarah's wedding dress goes up in flames; and sparks fly between Jamie and Violet at the bonfire party.

videos.title: Nov 7, 2007 (6681)
videos.overview: Violet grows concerned by Sean's attentiveness over her bump and reaches the end of her tether when she learns he has told all and sundry the sex of her unborn baby; a heartbroken Sarah is at her wits' end when David prepares to return to the salon; and Jodie can't forgive Jerry for pinning the blame for Finlay's accident on her.

videos.title: Nov 9, 2007 (6682)
videos.overview: Violet vents her anger at Marcus, threatening to report him to the hospital, then turns on Sean and reminds him he is only a donor and not a father; Fiz is delighted when John agrees to move in with her; Leanne takes Sarah on as a part-time waitress; and a dejected Jodie is dumped by Lloyd.

videos.title: Nov 11, 2007 (6683)
videos.overview: Furious with Jerry for meddling in her relationship with Lloyd, Jodie decides to leave the street. Liz and Steve come into conflict over who should move out of the Rovers; and Carla agrees to consider Tony's business proposition.

videos.title: Nov 12, 2007 Part 1 (6684)
videos.overview: Rosie returns to school and does her best to make John feel uncomfortable; Jerry struggles to cope without Jodie; and Sean realises he's not happy with Violet's decision about having the baby christened.

videos.title: Nov 12, 2007 Part 2 (6685)
videos.overview: Fiz prepares a meal for John but is furious to see him return home with Sally and Rosie; and David plans his next move when he realises Sarah and Jason have rekindled their love on a romantic date.

videos.title: Nov 14, 2007 (6686)
videos.overview: Jamie and Violet decide to give their relationship another chance and bring up the child together, while over in the pub Sean tells Marcus he wants to be a father to the baby; Rosie's flirtatious banter in the classroom leaves John feeling flustered; and Lloyd encourages Claire to join him at a singles' night.

videos.title: Nov 16, 2007 (6687)
videos.overview: A devastated Sean flees from the pub when he learns of Violet and Jamie's reconciliation and their plans to bring up the baby together; and Claire makes a fool of herself after getting drunk at the singles night and later admits to Ashley that she still loves him.

videos.title: Nov 18, 2007 (6688)
videos.overview: After a sleepless night, Sean decides Jamie has no right to be the father to Violet's baby, and considers taking legal action to formalise access to the child. Claire tells Ashley to collect his things from Audrey's and is touched when he later presents her with a gold necklace.

videos.title: Nov 19, 2007 Part 1 (6689)
videos.overview: An exasperated Fiz comes to blows with Sally after misreading her relationship with John; and Sean's insistence on involving lawyers in his quest for parental rights drives Violet and Jamie to look for their own place.

videos.title: Nov 19, 2007 Part 2 (6690)
videos.overview: Fiz joins forces with Kevin to get to the bottom of what's going on between Sally and John, while Rosie threatens to end her affair when her lover's jealousy gets the better of him.

videos.title: Nov 21, 2007 (6691)
videos.overview: Sarah begins to question Jason's fidelity when a scheming David infers her husband is secretly seeing Becky. Fiz thinks she's confirmed her suspicions about John and Sally as she tries to keep tabs on them; and Kayleigh accuses Jerry of neglect when he discovers she has been going clubbing for months.

videos.title: Nov 23, 2007 (6692)
videos.overview: David gets hold of Jason's mobile phone and spots another chance to stir things up; Fiz keeps tabs on John, who arranges to meet up at Rosie's when Sally goes Christmas shopping; Sean stubbornly refuses to make peace with Violet; and Jack and Vera consider leaving Weatherfield for Blackpool.

videos.title: Nov 25, 2007 (6693)
videos.overview: Fiz and Kevin trail their respective other halves in a bid to catch them out; David rouses Becky's interest when he subtly informs her that Sarah and Jason's relationship is rocky; and Marcus engineers a truce between Sean and Violet, who agree to make things work for the sake of the baby.

videos.title: Nov 26, 2007 Part 1 (6694)
videos.overview: Carla is confronted by a woman who claims to be Tony's wife, who warns her to stay away from him; Rosie takes advantage of her hold over John; and Sean goes to great lengths to stay in Violet's good books.

videos.title: Nov 26, 2007 Part 2 (6695)
videos.overview: Sean's offer leaves Violet and Jamie at odds with each other; a new arrival on the Street keeps the men enthralled with tales of party lifestyle in Ibiza; and Maria struggles to find the right moment to tell a distracted Liam about her pregnancy.

videos.title: Nov 28, 2007 (6696)
videos.overview: Maria arranges to meet Liam to tell him about her pregnancy, fearful it will mean the end of their relationship; Steve receives a phone call from his dad, telling him he is going to be released from prison the next day; and Lauren promises not to tell Jamie when she finds out about Sean's loan.

videos.title: Nov 30, 2007 (6697)
videos.overview: Steve makes his way to the prison to collect his dad, who declares his hell-raising days are over; Liam is less than happy about Carla's personal life and resolves to discover more about Tony; and John has some explaining to do when he marks Rosie's essay too leniently.

videos.title: Dec 2, 2007 (6698)
videos.overview: Liz fears her big day will be ruined when she learns Jim has been released from prison; Maria tells Liam she is going to have an abortion; and Norris has surprising news for Doreen.

videos.title: Dec 3, 2007 Part 1 (6699)
videos.overview: Liam continues stalking Tony and reports his findings to Carla, whose reaction prompts him to march out of the factory and propose to Maria; and new father-and-son bookies Harry and Dan Mason arrive on the Street.

videos.title: Dec 3, 2007 Part 2 (6700)
videos.overview: Carla tries to mask her emotions when she learns about Liam's engagement; David steals Becky's phone to send flirtatious texts to an amused Jason; and the new bookies stir up trouble for Steve.

videos.title: Dec 5, 2007 (6701)
videos.overview: David steals Jason's phone and gives it to Sarah, saying he found it in the street, before sending messages to it from Becky's handset; and Paul fears the loan he took out on his grandparents' house will be discovered when Jack and Vera announce they are selling up and moving to Blackpool.

videos.title: Dec 7, 2007 (6702)
videos.overview: David sends another provocative text message , but his luck runs out when Jason calls Becky's phone and Sarah hears it ringing in her brother's pocket; Ryan tells Michelle he thinks he's being followed; and the bookies clamp Lloyd's car.

videos.title: Dec 9, 2007 Part 2 (6703)
videos.overview: Michelle is frantic with worry when a panic-stricken Ryan reveals the stalker stopped his car and approached him; Gail suggests Sarah and Jason move out to avoid any more upset with David; and Paul confesses to Jack that he's taken out a loan in his name.

videos.title: Dec 10, 2007 Part 1 (6704)
videos.overview: Liam discovers the identity of Ryan's stalker as he waits to collect the youngster from school; Sarah makes Gail feel guilty; and Steve offers his dad a job.

videos.title: Dec 10, 2007 Part 2 (6705)
videos.overview: Michelle faces a barrage of questions about the stalker's allegations; a family meal gives David the chance to get Stephen on his side; and Jack lies to Vera.

videos.title: Dec 12, 2007 (6706)
videos.overview: Liz believes Jim has turned over a new leaf and offers to clear the air for Steve and Amy's sake; Michelle denies accusations that she had a fling behind Dean's back; and Sarah sees David wheedle his way into Stephen's good books.

videos.title: Dec 14, 2007 (6707)
videos.overview: David snaps up Stephen's offer of a job in Milan, leaving Sarah furious her brother has upstaged her once again; Liz softens towards Jim, but Vernon becomes paranoid about the jailbird's return; and Rosie makes a play for John when he goes for a lesson with Sally.

videos.title: Dec 16, 2007 (6708)
videos.overview: An irate Sarah resolves to put an end to David's Italian dream; Dan takes a shine to Mel's friend from the police force; and Rosie grows frustrated by her snatched moments with John.

videos.title: Dec 17, 2007 Part 1 (6709)
videos.overview: Michelle decides to confront Ryan's stalker but is shocked by what she finds; a gloating David mocks Sarah's earlier threat to him; and Tony makes a bold move as he tries to win over Carla.

videos.title: Dec 17, 2007 Part 2 (6710)
videos.overview: Ryan's stalker reveals some startling information to Michelle about her son; David is unnerved by Sarah's sudden change of heart; and Dan takes Abi back to his flat.

videos.title: Dec 19, 2007 (6711)
videos.overview: Sarah procures some Ecstasy and continues playing happy families as she steps up her plan to shatter David's dream; Nick tracks down Michelle at the Rovers and asks her to take a DNA test; Vernon finds Jim's shared past with Liz preying on his mind; and Rosie begins to lose patience with John when he ignores her texts and calls.

videos.title: Dec 21, 2007 (6712)
videos.overview: Sarah plants the Ecstasy tablets in David's drawer at the salon, where they are subsequently discovered by Audrey; Liam is furious to find Tony has laid on a Christmas do at the factory, and even more annoyed to see him canoodling with Carla; and Rosie blackmails John into booking a night away together.

videos.title: Dec 23, 2007 (6713)
videos.overview: Still reeling from the shock of discovering Ryan may not be her son, Michelle breaks down in Steve's arms; and Maria is horrified by a callous remark made by Carla at Liz's hen night.

videos.title: Dec 24, 2007 Part 1 (6714)
videos.overview: Rosie tells John she wants a proper relationship and threatens to expose their affair if he doesn't leave Fiz; Michelle faces up to her fears about Ryan; and Sarah tries to steal David's new life for herself.

videos.title: Dec 24, 2007 Part 2 (6715)
videos.overview: John makes a half-hearted attempt to end things with Fiz; and Stephen offers Jason the job he had earmarked for David in Milan.

videos.title: Dec 25, 2007 (6716)
videos.overview: John's philandering ways are exposed when he mixes up Rosie's and Fiz's gifts. An explosive encounter ensues in which Kevin knocks the unfaithful teacher to the ground and is arrested by the police. Michelle tries to play happy families for Ryan's sake; Roy faces the festive season without Hayley; and Jason agrees to make the move to Milan with an ecstatic Sarah.

videos.title: Dec 26, 2007 Part 2 (6717)
videos.overview: Rosie shows no remorse for her actions as John's life is left in tatters and he prepares to leave; and Sarah picks the right moment to tell her family about the move to Milan - leaving David infuriated.

videos.title: Dec 28, 2007 (6718)
videos.overview: As Sarah celebrates her new life with a farewell party in the pub, David adds fuel to Jason's fears about the move; Kevin prepares for his court appearance; and Maria offers Fiz a shoulder to cry on.

videos.title: Fri Jan 01 2010 Part 1
videos.overview: Steve and Becky didn't have a very good start to the year as they continued to argue about having children. "No kid of mine would amount to any good. Not with my rotten genes!" Becky declared when Steve pushed her. Will that be the end of the discussion? Meanwhile, Michelle had a motherly chat with Ryan to check that he and Sian weren't having unprotected sex, while Sophie continued to give her mate a hard time for breaking her chastity vow. Elsewhere, Audrey was annoyed when Natasha forgot they were supposed to be going to a stylists dinner party together and decided to call male escort Lewis instead. Lewis accepted the invitation much to Audrey's delight. Finally, Steve and Becky pondered whether they had rushed into getting married and what the future would hold now that they had reached such an obstacle.

videos.title: Fri Jan 01 2010 Part 2
videos.overview: Audrey prepared for her evening with male escort Lewis but got cold feet at the last minute. Meanwhile, Tyrone told Molly he’d been talking to the wife of a big motoring company owner in Chester and she’d hinted that they might have a job for him. Elsewhere, Becky paid the Croppers a visit to chat about her problems with Steve and to tell them that she didn’t want children. Hayley and Roy were a shoulder for her to cry on but when she returned to the Rovers it was clear that Steve was growing tired of her attitude towards starting a family. Lewis finally persuaded Audrey to leave the house with him and they shared a lovely evening together. In fact, Audrey was in such a good mood that she later offered to pay for Gail’s honeymoon as a wedding present. Finally, poor Becky spent the night on the sofa after her and Steve failed to resolve their problems.
