Tim realises he's a bigamist. Ken, Peter and Adam are shocked by the state of Daniel's flat. Bernie sends Kel a message from Alfie.

videos.title: Wednesday, 11th December 2019
videos.overview: Daniel gets drunk and steps out in front of Cathy's car. Tim meets up with his other wife, Charlie. Maria confronts Gary about how he really makes his money. Michelle boots Robert out of the Bistro.

videos.title: Friday, 13th December 2019
videos.overview: Robert is arrested on suspicion of assault. Tim proposes to Sally. Geoff humiliates Yasmeen at their wedding party. Gemma and Chesney finally bring their quads home, but struggle to cope. Michael does a deal with Big Garth.

videos.title: Monday, 16th December 2019 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Robert and Paula pick over the evidence against him, while Chesney and Gemma get by with a little help from their friends. Elsewhere, Tim discovers that his plan is fundamentally flawed.

videos.title: Monday, 16th December 2019 (part 2)
videos.overview: Michelle's revelations prompt the police to charge Robert, and Gemma feels under scrutiny during the Freshco photo shoot. Meanwhile, Roy shows an interest in Richard's hobby.

videos.title: Wednesday, 18th December 2019 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Roy makes an error of judgement by leaving Richard unattended, and Michelle receives a mystery offer for the Bistro. Elsewhere, Ryan begs Gary for work to pay off his debt.

videos.title: Wednesday, 18th December 2019 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Nina lays the blame on Roy, and Michael waits in vain for a visit from Grace and Tianna. Elsewhere, Ryan completes a mission for Gary.

videos.title: Friday, 20th December 2019
videos.overview: Robert's court hearing is delayed when new information comes to light, and Gary gets wind of Derek's plot to sell the factory. Meanwhile, Roy attempts to make peace with Nina.

videos.title: Monday, 23rd December 2019 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Nick and Sarah unveil the refurbished factory to the staff, keeping quiet about Derek's change of heart, while Sean reveals to an appalled Fiz that Jade is living on the streets. Rita tells Gemma she has arranged to visit Mavis over Christmas, despite the fact she has no plans to go anywhere. Emma and Seb become a couple, but will Alina ruin their romance?

videos.title: Monday, 23rd December 2019 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Gary lies to Maria that Derek ran into financial trouble, so he swooped in to save the factory and the workers' jobs. Later, he locks a tied-up Derek in the furniture shop overnight, determined to make sure he misses his flight to Florida with his kids. Fiz and Tyrone find Jade on Victoria Street and drag her back to No 9 and, while Rita decorates her tree alone, Emma informs Seb that Alina came looking for him.

videos.title: Tuesday, December 24th 2019
videos.overview: Gary frees Derek from his bonds, and Fiz calls at the furniture shop to drop off items from a house clearance, including a live antique gun. In the Rovers, a drunk Ali vows to win back Maria and see Gary get his comeuppance. Elsewhere, Marion rails at Shona and David for banning Max from seeing her.

videos.title: Wednesday, 25th December 2019
videos.overview: Gary's stunned to find the furniture shop door open, and the gun and its ammunition missing. A worse-for-wear Derek lurches into the Rovers looking for Windass, pulls out a gun and fires a shot. Shona's plan for David's treasure hunt is soon forgotten when she and the Platts find themselves in the middle of a shootout. And while Seb comes to a decision about his future with Emma, Michelle puts her affairs in order as she makes plans to leave Weatherfield.

videos.title: Thursday, 26th December 2019
videos.overview: Following one of the most dramatic Christmas Days in Weatherfield history, the long-suffering Street residents come to terms with the aftermath and try to get their lives back in order.

videos.title: Friday, 27th December 2019
videos.overview: Michelle heads to the bistro to hand over the keys to the new owner, but when the mystery buyer turns out to be Ray, she sets about smashing up the place. Elsewhere, Ali reveals that he's told the police about Gary's secret life as a loan shark, and a mortified Fiz confesses to Tyrone and Jade how she bought a gun for the shop, and it was then stolen.

videos.title: Monday, 30th December 2019 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Gary's true colours are finally revealed. Ray goes into competition with the Rovers.

videos.title: Monday, 30th December 2019 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Abi leaves Kevin disappointed. Tracy's grateful when Paula offers Amy some work experience.

videos.title: Tuesday, 31st December 2019
videos.overview: Tracy drowns her sorrows after a row with Steve. Ray offers Michelle's old job to Alya. The Barlows raise a toast to Sinead.

videos.title: Wednesday, 1st January 2020
videos.overview: Tracy realises she has cheated on Steve. There's a stand-off at the factory. Abi hurts Kevin's Feelings again.

videos.title: Friday, 3rd January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Josh stands trial for raping David. Evelyn warns Fiz and Tyrone that there's something fishy about Jade.

videos.title: Friday, 3rd January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Steve confronts Tracy - does he know about her fling?

videos.title: Monday, 6th January 2020
videos.overview: Fiz and Tyrone get a visit from social services, who have had reports about Hope being injured. Gary is taken in by the police to bow to Freshco's demands. Amy starts her work experience with Paula and demands a wage.

videos.title: Wednesday, 8th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Fiz and Tyrone are questioned about the gun used in the shooting. Leanne overhears Tracy begging her lover to keep quiet.

videos.title: Wednesday, 8th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Aggie is interviewed by a reporter about her Christmas Day heroics.

videos.title: Friday, 10th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Sally's hot tub hosts an awkward reunion for Tracy, while Gemma and Chesney discover they are easily replaceable. Elsewhere, Aggie explains her change of career to Roy.

videos.title: Friday, 10th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Tracy confesses all to a horrified Steve, and Bernie's meddling sends Dev into a rage. Meanwhile, Cathy confides in Brian about her concerns for Yasmeen.

videos.title: Monday, 13th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Fiz tells the police the truth about the gun. Cathy worries about Yasmeen. Steve asks Tracy to marry him again.

videos.title: Friday, 10th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Tracy confesses all to a horrified Steve, and Bernie's meddling sends Dev into a rage. Meanwhile, Cathy confides in Brian about her concerns for Yasmeen.

videos.title: Wednesday, 15th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Geoff makes out that Yasmeen is an alcoholic • Fiz gets a suspended prison sentence and fine.

videos.title: Wednesday, 15th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Shona opens her eyes but doesn't recognise David • Bernie tells Sean about her plan to get justice for Paul.

videos.title: Friday, 17th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: David tries desperately to trigger Shona's memory • Bernie hunts down Kel, helped by Paul, Billy and Gemma.

videos.title: Friday, 17th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Jade books oneway ferry tickets to France for her and Hope. Geoff manipulates Yasmeen into staying at home. Abi gets her GCSE results.

videos.title: Monday, 20th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Tyrone and Evelyn are shocked when Ruby reveals that Jade put the bruises on Hope's arm with make-up, while Billy urges Paul to accept that Kel may never be punished for his crimes and to move on with his life. As an exhausted Gemma takes a nap with the quads, someone pushes a burning rag through the letterbox and a fire quickly takes hold.

videos.title: Monday, 20th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Fiz returns home following Hope's disclosure, and Christine questions Jade, but she sticks to her story, accusing the flame-haired mum of abusing her daughter. Chesney arrives home to find flames licking at the door, David seeks Max's understanding, and when Kevin makes a snide remark about her landing herself a sugar daddy, Abi storms out.

videos.title: Wednesday, 22nd January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Tyrone and Fiz are horrified to discover the back door unlocked and Hope gone. Tim's shocked to find Charlie on his doorstep, and she tells him he can forget about the divorce as she cannot afford the legal fees. Bethany is gutted when Alya reveals that Ray has made her the bistro's new manager.

videos.title: Wednesday, 22nd January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Fiz shows the police the passports and ferry tickets, convinced Jade has abducted Hope. Carla tells an appalled Bethany how Ray made Michelle sign a gagging order, and Charlie returns to No 4 with her bags and explains she's been evicted.

videos.title: Friday, 24th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Yasmeen finds Jade lying unconscious in the ginnel, and Fiz looks like the prime suspect. Charlie tells Tim how much cash she wants before she will sign any divorce papers. Bethany discusses career options with Daniel, but he suggests she might be best to leave Weatherfield altogether.

videos.title: Friday, 24th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: The police wonder if Fiz can shed any light on Jade's assault, Daniel panics as he takes Bertie's temperature, and Bernie tells Paul that she is moving on. Meanwhile, Tim's plan to send Charlie on her way doesn't work out as planned when he finds her working at the Rovers.

videos.title: Monday, 27th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Daniel discovers Bertie barely conscious and urges Peter to call an ambulance. Maria insists Gary should go to Bristol.

videos.title: Monday, 27th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Beth rails at Daniel for endangering Bertie's life. In an attempt to get the babies to sleep, Gemma suggests to Chesney that they take them for a walk.

videos.title: Wednesday, 29th January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Gemma and Chesney realise they've been removed from the marketing campaign. Daniel thanks Bethany for helping him through a terrible ordeal.

videos.title: Wednesday, 29th January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Imran advises a furious Gemma that there's nothing she can do about Freshco's advertising decisions.

videos.title: Friday, 31st January 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Sally is horrified to find out that everyone knows Tim is a bigamist. Alya assures Yasmin that her drinking is fine. Geoff does his best to undermine Yasmeen's confidence.

videos.title: Friday, 31st January 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Daniel confuses Bethany for Sinead and kisses her. Geoff spreads lies about Yasmeen's drinking.

videos.title: Monday, 3rd February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Geoff is fuming when his trick does not work, and Maria explains to Liam she has lost the baby. When a dishevelled Nina calls in at the cafe. Roy's pleased to see her while Carla is concerned.

videos.title: Monday, 3rd February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Tim is surprised to see his dad can't see the funny side over the botched trick, and Gary assures Maria that he wants to be with her, baby or not. Steve and Tracy decide it's time to be honest with each other, and Sarah warns Bethany to tread carefully after sleeping with Daniel.

videos.title: Wednesday, 5th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Geoff locks a terrified Yasmin in his magic box. Nina admits to Roy and Carla that she's homeless.

videos.title: Wednesday, 5th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Bethany refuses to bow to Roy's demands. Time tries and fails, to worm his way back in with Sally.

videos.title: Friday, 7th February 2020
videos.overview: In a special episode - Corrie's 10,000 show - Rita discovers her ex-husband Dennis has died and is supported by friends as she heads to Blackpool to spread his ashes. But, the trip doesn't go according to plan.....

videos.title: Monday, 10th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Bethany warns Alya that Ray is probably trying to get her into bed, an exhausted David crashes while taking the kids to the school play, and Eileen calls in the factory, hoping to apply for the Customer Services job.

videos.title: Monday, 10th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Having downloaded Ray's legal files, Bethany and Daniel find a list of names including Michelle's with an asterisk next to them. David, Max and Lily extract themselves from the car wreckage, while Eileen and Alina are interviewed for the Underworld job.

videos.title: Wednesday, 12th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Ray tries to convince Alya that he did not have designs on her, and David is devastated when the doctor reveals Shona does not want to see him. When Alina reveals that she's looking for somewhere to live, Seb suggests to Emma that she could move in with them.

videos.title: Wednesday, 12th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Abi is shocked to hear the allegations about Ray, while Maria hands David her keys, telling him she would like him to have her car. Ryan hands Gary an envelope full of cash and confirms it's the last of his debt collections.

videos.title: Friday, 14th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Maria voices her suspicions to Ali about Gary, while Tim, Sally and Abi discuss the online article exposing Ray as a sex pest. Beth tears a strip off Daniel and Bethany for jumping into bed together when Sinead's only been dead a few months.

videos.title: Friday, 14th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Maria confronts Gary about his shady dealings, Abi turns up at the charity gala with a plan, while Daniel tells the Rovers regulars that he and Bethany are now an item. Elsewhere, Sarah and Adam broach the subject of their wedding with David.

videos.title: Monday, 17th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Ray tells Abi he's reported her to the police for stealing his car and torching it. Knowing the house to be empty, James takes Danny back to No 3 and leads him up the stairs. And Gemma's horrified to realise the Freshco photoshoot clashes with Aled's hearing appointment.

videos.title: Monday, 17th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Ali calls at Maria's flat and begs her to give their relationship a chance, convinced she feels the same way about him. Gemma tells Chesney that Frescho will have to reschedule the photoshoot as Aled's doctor's appointment is far more important, and it looks like Ed may discover Danny and James's relationship.

videos.title: Wednesday, 19th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Ali calls at Maria's flat and begs her to give their relationship a chance, convinced she feels the same way about him. Gemma tells Chesney that Frescho will have to reschedule the photoshoot as Aled's doctor's appointment is far more important, and it looks like Ed may discover Danny and James's relationship.

videos.title: Wednesday, 19th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Tara tells Chesney that he's trashed the Freshco's brand and she's terminating their contract, Ed is convinced that Danny has corrupted James, and Maria tells a thrilled Gary that she'd love to marry him.

videos.title: Friday, 21st February 2020
videos.overview: Chesney panics when Joseph goes missing, and Ali begs Maria not to marry Gary. After spending the night with Kevin, Abi's cautious about confusing Jack, and Adam's not pleased to learn that Sarah's invited the whole factory to their wedding.

videos.title: Monday, 24th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: An upbeat James looks forward to meeting Danny later, Bethany tells Sarah she believes Ray is blocking all her attempts to get restaurant jobs, and when Ray gets Abi alone in the garage he reveals that a friend's dashcam footage shows her stealing his car.

videos.title: Monday, 24th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Sarah informs Beth that Bethany will be starting work at the factory tomorrow and she expects her to be made welcome, Danny tells James he doesn't want to continue seeing him, and as Kevin awaits Abi's arrival for tea he is shocked to find Ray on his doorstep.

videos.title: Wednesday, 26th February 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Kevin confesses to Tyrone that he's being blackmailed by Ray, Gemma attends a baby senses class with the quads, and Peter calls at No.1 with the intention of telling Ken that he no longer wants the house.

videos.title: Wednesday, 26th February 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Sarah implores Bethany not to let her feelings for Daniel stand in the way of her career, Vanessa suggests Gemma should come to her baby yoga class, and Tyrone is furious with Kevin for putting their business in jeopardy to help Abi

videos.title: Friday, 28th February 2020
videos.overview: Geoff returns home and rails at Yasmeen for failing to have his dinner on the table, and when she explains she was cleaning out the chicken coop and lost track of time, his mood darkens. Sally invites Kevin round for dinner with Abi before heading off to Sarah's hen night and leaving them to sort out their differences, and Tracy urges Steve to up their offer on the house in the hope that it'll top Peter's bid.

videos.title: Monday, 2nd March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Daniel bags up Sinead's belongings for Beth. Alya seeks the true story behind Yasmeen's tears. Sarah and Bethany remain at loggerheads.

videos.title: Monday, 2nd March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: The Barlows and Platts convene for Adam and Sarah's wedding. Yasmeen's absence sends Geoff into a panic. Jade gets short shrift from Tyrone.

videos.title: Wednesday, 4th March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Daniel resolves to prove his devotion to Bethany. Tyrone's act of kindness misleads Jade. Geoff offers to pay for Sally and Tim's wedding.

videos.title: Wednesday, 4th March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Bethany realises the time has come to leave Weatherfield. Tyrone and Fiz unite against Jade. Adam dupes Ali into revealing his fling with Maria.

videos.title: Friday, 6th March 2020
videos.overview: Gary reels when he runs into Adam, who can't resist sharing some information he has learnt about Maria and Ali. When Gary asks Ryan if it's true, a scared Ryan denies it. Ryan later tells Ali that he's saved his bacon. Craig vows to get fit.

videos.title: Monday, 9th March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Gary asks Sharon to teach Ali a lesson, and a reporter asks James about rumours regarding his sexuality circulating on social media. Roy's fellow bat-watchers are horrified by Nina's attire and deeply suspicious of her motives.

videos.title: Monday, 9th March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: A terrified Gary leaves a message for Sharon telling her that if Ali dies, she is to blame, and James receives a worrying text from his manager. Roy resigns from the bat-watching group after some of the members' remarks about Nina's dress sense.

videos.title: Wednesday, 11th March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Ali assures Ryan that Gary, or someone hired by Windass, must have spiked his drink, and Alya confronts Geoff about her belief he is behind the nasty online reviews for Speed Daal. Aggie reveals that they've had several calls from newspapers wanting to get James's side of the story.

videos.title: Wednesday, 11th March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: James lies to his Manager and Press Officer and assures them he is not gay, and Ali takes Maria on a terrifying car ride. Meanwhile, Nina wonders if Roy's ashamed to be seen with her after claiming the meeting with the bat group has been cancelled.

videos.title: Friday, 13th March 2020
videos.overview: Geoff tries to persuade Yasmeen that Alya is out to get him, while Gary convinces Maria that he did nothing to provoke Ali and that the guy is a maniac. Audrey worries that Ken is being railroaded into moving to Stillwaters against his will, and Imran puts pressure on Toyah to find a new job.

videos.title: Monday, 16th March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Alya learns that Geoff and Yasmeen intend to sell up and move away. Claudia volunteers Ken to give a talk to their new neighbours. Bernie returns to find Gemma struggling to cope.

videos.title: Monday, 16th March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Evelyn bumps into her ex-boyfriend Arthur at the vets. Alya begs Yasmeen to leave controlling Geoff. Norris fills Ken in on life at Stillwaters.

videos.title: Wednesday, 18th March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Alya discovers Geoff has a violent past. Gemma's upset when Imogen and Vanessa lie to her.

videos.title: Wednesday, 18th March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Emma decides to play it cool with Seb. Evelyn and Arthur reminisce about how they almost tied the knot.

videos.title: Friday, 20th March 2020
videos.overview: David discovers Shona has been in contact with Clayton. Gemma breaks down after the quads are put in danger. Yasmeen turns her back on Alya. Emma fears Seb is still into Alina. Evelyn prepares for a date with old flame Arthur, with a little help from Claudia.

videos.title: Monday, 23rd March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: It becomes clear that Gemma is not coping with motherhood and even the health visitor question her about her state of mind. But later, as the babies' crying escalates, she heads into the yard to calm herself - and realises with horror she is locked out. Alya introduces Yasmeen to a police officer who has information about Geoff - but scared, she refuses to listen and rushed out. David begs Clayton to leave Shona alone, Tyrone gives Arthur a piece of his mind for standing Evelyn up, and Norris reluctantly joins Ken for the Stillwaters' art class.

videos.title: Monday, 23rd March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Bernie arrives to find Gemma in such a distressed state, so she agrees to move in and help with the babies - on the condition that she doesn't tell Chesney that Gemma isn't coping. Nick tries to talk to Shona but she refuses to see him, passing on a message to David instead. Arthur apologises to Evelyn and asks her to give him another chance, and Ken and Norris sneak out to the Rovers for a treat.

videos.title: Wednesday, 25th March 2020 (Part 1)
videos.overview: David is devastated about Shona's divorce request but claims it will give him a chance to move on - and when he finds Alina alone in Victoria Garden, it is clear there is a spark between them. News of a family wedding gives Alya the chance she needs to get Yasmeen away from Geoff. The only problem is, they are not invited. Bernie forces Gemma to seek medical help, Evelyn summons Claudia for another makeover and Charles is outraged to discover Ken has smuggled Eccles the dog into his apartment.

videos.title: Wednesday, 25th March 2020 (Part 2)
videos.overview: An argument in the Rovers turns to blows when David accuses Seb of being jealous of his friendship with Alina - and when Emma realises her boyfriend still has feeling for his ex, she tells him to find somewhere else to stay. Gemma plays down her depression and assures the doctor she is just exhausted, leaving Bernie frustrated by her daughter's refusal to accept help. Alya and Ryan tell Yasmeen they have been invited to Zeedan's wedding in Spain. Now all they have to do is tell Geoff, who is not on the guest list.

videos.title: Monday, 30th March 2020
videos.overview: Geoff feigns illness to sabotage Yasmeen's plans. Seb pledges his heart to Emma. Reckless David places himself in harm's way.

videos.title: Wednesday, 1st April 2020
videos.overview: Alya tackles Geoff about his lies. David flees from a group of muggers. Ken demands a copy of the Stillwaters rule book from Charles.

videos.title: Friday, 3rd April 2020
videos.overview: Yasmeen confronts Geoff with the contents of his emails, Gemma tries to be positive as Aled's hearing aid is fitted and David apologises for using Alina.

videos.title: Monday, 6th April 2020
videos.overview: Geoff despairs as Yasmeen walks out on him, Bernie implores Chesney to keep a close eye on Gemma, and Michael attends a job interview at Underworld. David heads out for a walk, but when Gail quizzes him, he refuses to tell her where he's going.

videos.title: Wednesday, 8th April 2020
videos.overview: Gemma boards the bus with the quads, but is suddenly overcome by a wave of anxiety and hurries off the bus, leaving her babies behind. The return of Rick's daughter Kelly rattles Gary, and Yasmeen consults the police about Geoff's past.

videos.title: Friday, 10th April 2020
videos.overview: Steve regrets prioritising Emma's needs over Oliver's, Gemma returns home and finally admits to Chesney that she thinks she's a terrible mother and no longer feels in control, while Ken decides to challenge Charles' supremacy.

videos.title: Monday, 13th April 2020
videos.overview: Leanne is livid to learn Steve left Oliver with Summer. Gemma is diagnosed with postnatal depression. Ken's Still waters election campaign gets off to a bad start. May and Asha are love rivals.

videos.title: Wednesday, 15th April 2020
videos.overview: Naked photos of Asha are posted to a group chat. Leanne discovers Steve is taking legal advice about Oliver. Johnny is unnerved by new B&B guest Scott. Charles challenges Ken to a fencing match.

videos.title: Friday, 17th April 2020
videos.overview: Asha's devastated to discover her pics have gone viral. Steve and Leanne row over Oliver. Johnny suggests a holiday to Jenny, in a bid to avoid Scott, Ken learns Charles has been ripping off the residents.

videos.title: Monday, 20th April 2020
videos.overview: Asha feels the eyes of the world on her. Ken publicly exposes Charles' financial fraud. Carla agrees to take charge at the Rovers.

videos.title: Wednesday, 22nd April 2020
videos.overview: Gary intervenes in Amy and Kelly's fight. Ken tells Claudia that Stillwaters will never be his home. Johnny feels uneasy leaving Scott at the Rovers.

videos.title: Friday, 24th April 2020
videos.overview: Cathy comes round for a natter but Geoff manipulates the situation so that Yasmeen ends up offending her and she storms out in a fury. Gary finds Kelly in tears. Asha implores Dev not to go to the police about the video.

videos.title: Monday, 27th April 2020
videos.overview: Yasmeen heads to the medical centre.  Geoff declares that Yasmeen caught the STI from Sharif. Kelly’s mum Laura visits Gary at the furniture shop.

videos.title: Wednesday, 29th April 2020
videos.overview: Daniel returns from the grief retreat and Ken’s pleased to hear he found it a great help. Dev see how distraught his daughter is and finally agrees to phone the school and try to withdraw his complaint.

videos.title: Friday, 1st May 2020
videos.overview: Yasmeen finally snaps after months of abuse. Yasmeen is shocked to discover Geoff has agreed to pay for their wedding.

videos.title: Monday, 4th May 2020
videos.overview: Yasmeen faces the consequences of her red mist, as the paramedics attend to Geoff. The police question the regulars about Geoff and Yasmeen’s relationship.

videos.title: Wednesday, 6th May 2020
videos.overview:
An exhausted Yasmeen sits in her police cell.

When Dev blames Kelly for heaping so much trouble on Asha, Gary leaps to Kelly’s defence leaving Adam intrigued.

A loved up Adam and Sarah return from their honeymoon.

videos.title: Friday, 8th May 2020
videos.overview:
Alya tells Sally that Geoff has been controlling Yasmeen for months and she’s never had a drink problem.  Imran watches as a bewildered and upset Yasmeen is charged.

Max delivers his speech at the Outreach Awards and looks with disappointment at David’s empty chair.

videos.title: Monday 11th May 2020
videos.overview:
Steve meets up with Leanne at the nursery school that they are looking at for Oliver and the head teacher offers to show them round.

Nervous Yasmeen attends her bail hearing and sees Imran take the stand as Geoff and Sally look on. Will she be granted bail?

Cathy complains to Dev about Bernie and threatens to leave the kebab shop. However when Dev offers her an extra 50p an hour, Cathy changes her mind.

videos.title: Wednesday 13th May 2020
videos.overview:
Steve and Leanne fear for their son after his seizure and describe Oliver’s symptoms to the doctor.

In the kebab shop, Cathy and Bernie bury the hatchet and Bernie agrees to knuckle down.

Alya calls at the Rovers and tells Sean how Yasmeen is the victim of domestic abuse and she is determined to take Geoff down.

videos.title: Friday 15th May 2020
videos.overview:
When Don makes another racist comment, Ed just lets it go leaving Michael confused.

To Steve and Leanne’s relief, Oliver seems much better.

Craig suggests to David they go for a run together and it’s clear David wants to get out of it.

videos.title: Monday, 18th May 2020
videos.overview: Steve and Leanne await the outcome of Oliver's tests. The Baileys display differing attitudes to racial abuse. Gemma realises that she's not alone.

videos.title: Wednesday, 20th May 2020
videos.overview:
Steve and Leanne Battersby keep a vigil at Oliver’s bedside. Having googled mitochondrial disease, Steve’s upbeat as he explains that there are different strains and many people with the disease lead full and normal lives.

Gemma tells Bernie and Chesney that she feels like she’s turned a corner and she couldn’t have done it without them and the support group.

videos.title: Friday, 22nd May 2020
videos.overview:
Ed has had enough and challenges him and as the room falls silent he explains he’s suffered racist abuse all his life, but he’ll never give up the fight to put a stop to it.

Michael assures Tianna that there’s no place in this world for racism and he’ll do everything he can to make it a better place for her.

Aggie tells Ed that she’s proud of him for standing up to Don but wishes she could be proud of the way he is with James too.

videos.title: Monday, 25th May 2020
videos.overview: Oliver has his sedation reduced. James faces his demons at football training. David seeks an outlet for his rage when he learns the latest about Shona.

videos.title: Wednesday, 27th May 2020
videos.overview: Clayton takes advantage of Shona's memory loss. Leanne insists that Oliver will make a full recovery. James worries that he made the wrong decision.

videos.title: Friday, 29th May 2020
videos.overview: Shona requests that David stays away during her home visit. Tim collects Geoff from hospital. Dev accuses Asha's school of failing to protect her.

videos.title: Monday, 1st June 2020
videos.overview: Geoff gains entry to Number 6 to delete the CCTV footage. Roy finds Shona lurking outside the cafe. Dev decides to move the twins to Oakhill School.

videos.title: Wednesday, 3rd June 2020
videos.overview: Alya makes a shocking discovery regarding Geoff. Asha's problems follow her to her new school. Roy invites Shona to move into his flat.

videos.title: Friday, 5th June 2020
videos.overview: Asha Alahan comes face to face with Corey and his cronies. Realising the truth will come out in court, Geoff admits he hired escorts as Yasmeen refused him sex. Roy and David visit Shona at the rehab centre.

videos.title: Monday, 8th June 2020
